summary: Jitsi Video Bridge is a Selective Forwarding Unit that handles multi-party video communication using WebRTC. It routes media streams between participants in a conference rather than mixing them centrally, which reduces processing overhead on the host server.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want to build or integrate an open-source video conferencing infrastructure using Java components.
watchOut: Setting up and maintaining a WebRTC media server can involve complex network configurations, including STUN/TURN servers and UDP port management.
deployNotes: As a Java application typically distributed via deb packages, it usually runs on a dedicated Linux host and requires a reverse proxy for handling web traffic and TLS termination.
